model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of three different methods, labeled as lattice, FLAT, and OURS, over a series of epochs. The x-axis, labeled "epoch (次)," represents the number of epochs, ranging from 0 to 18, with a tick label interval of 2. The y-axis, labeled "F1-score," measures the performance of the methods, ranging from 0.55 to 0.90, with a tick label interval of 0.05. The lattice method is represented by a red line with square markers, the FLAT method by a blue line with circle markers, and the OURS method by a yellow line with triangle markers. The lattice method starts at an F1-score of approximately 0.60 at epoch 0 and shows a steady increase, reaching an F1-score of about 0.85 at epoch 18. The FLAT method begins at an F1-score of around 0.70 at epoch 0, with a more gradual increase, ending at an F1-score of approximately 0.90 at epoch 18. The OURS method starts at an F1-score of about 0.80 at epoch 0, with a steady increase, reaching an F1-score of around 0.90 at epoch 18. The plot does not provide any inferred conclusions or comparisons between the methods.
